column3: tathā hi dūrād rūpaṃ paśyati akṣisthamañjanaṃ na paśyati ||
dūrācchabdaṃ śṛṇoti sati ca prāptaviṣayatve divyaṃ cakṣuḥśrotramiha manuṣyeṣu dhyāyināṃ nopajāyeta ghrāṇādivat ||
yadyaprāptaviṣayaṃ cakṣuḥ kasmānna sarvamaprāptaṃ paśyati dūraṃ tiraskṛtaṃ ca kathaṃ tāvadayaskānto na sarvamaprāptam
kasmānna sarvaṃ prāptaṃ paśyatyañjanaṃ śalākāṃ vā ||
yathā ca ghrāṇādīnāṃ hi prāpto viṣayo na tu sarvaḥ sahabhūgandhādyagrahaṇād evaṃ cakṣuṣo .pyaprāptaḥ syāt na tu sarvaḥ ||
kecit punaḥ śrotraṃ prāptāprāptaviṣayaṃ manyante karṇābhyantare.pi śabdaśravaṇāt ||
